children: The Canadian dollar strengthened against the greenback on Wednesday, and the yield on benchmark government debt climbed.
was trading 0% higher at C$1.3777 to the greenback, or 72.58 U.S. cents, after trading in a range of 1.3767 to 1.3789.
Canadian government 10-year bond yields (CA10YT=RR) rose 1.4 basis points to 3.825%. The yield on similar U.S. government benchmark debt rose to 4.8104%.
futures rose $2.87 to $95.9 a barrel on Wednesday.
